device_requirement: CUDA (no CPU fallback, no remote API)

prompt.system: You are a professional translator. Translate the user's {src} text into {tgt}. Preserve the meaning exactly. Output only the {tgt} translation, with no explanations, notes, transliteration or quotation marks.

entry_point: python solution/main.py translate --text TEXT --source-language English --target-language German --output OUT.json
